title: Barcelona
subtitle: One or two must-sees a day. The rest is yours to wander.
facts: Fly in Fri 13:45 · Vueling VY8101 · T1
Fly out Mon 18:10 · Aegean A3743 · T1
Monday 12 Oct is a public holiday
Prices checked late Sept 2026 — confirm on official sites before booking

goodToKnow: Both your flights use T1: Vueling in, Aegean out.
Arriving: Aerobús A1 leaves from right outside arrivals, every ~5–10 min, ~35 min to Plaça Catalunya.
Leaving: allow ~2 h before your 18:10 flight. Aegean Light fare = no checked bag, so go straight to security if you've checked in online.
Taxi to or from the hotel (Sant Gervasi): ~25–35 min, roughly €35–45.
Aerobús A2 serves T2.
Allow ~35 min from Plaça Catalunya.
Aerobús A1 ends and starts here. A1 is the Terminal 1 bus, which is what you need both ways.
The airport-bound stop isn't the same as the arrival drop-off. Check aerobusbarcelona.es for the exact spot.
FGC Catalunya station is on the square: take L6, S1 or S2 to Muntaner for the hotel (not L7, it doesn't stop there).
The T-casual card works on FGC and metro, but NOT on the Aerobús.

dontMiss: Las Meninas series (1957): 58 variations on Velázquez. This is the one to see.
The Pigeons paintings from Cannes, part of the same 1957 donation.
Science and Charity (1897), painted when Picasso was 15.
First Communion (1896), his first big exhibited canvas.
The Blue Period rooms (1901–1904).
The Gothic courtyards of the medieval palaces the museum sits in.
goodToKnow: Allow ~1.5 h. Big bags go in the cloakroom.
Most museums close on Mondays, which is why this is on Friday.
Santa Maria del Mar is a 4-minute walk away.

dontMiss: The corner façade with its mosaic columns and sculpture group.
Peek into the foyer café if it's open.
The huge, spare Catalan Gothic nave, with very slim columns for its size.
The rose window at dusk.
goodToKnow: Free to enter outside tour hours; rooftop tours are paid.

dontMiss: El Born Centre de Cultura: free to walk in and see the excavated 1714 streets.

goodToKnow: Small tapas and wine bars everywhere. Dinner from 21:00, like the locals.
One of the best neighbourhoods for just getting lost.

dontMiss: Sunset is ~19:15. The beach faces east, so you'll watch the colours over the sea rather than the sun going down.
goodToKnow: Pickpockets: front pocket or zipped bag, and never leave your phone on the towel or table.

dontMiss: El Drac, the mosaic dragon/salamander on the main stairway.
The Hypostyle Room: 86 columns with Jujol's mosaic ceiling medallions.
The wavy serpentine bench on Nature Square, plus the view.
The two gatehouse pavilions at the main entrance (the 'gingerbread houses').
The Laundry Room Portico, with its leaning stone columns like a wave.
goodToKnow: You get 30 minutes of grace after your slot time, and you can stay as long as you like once inside.
The free forest area above has the Turó de les Tres Creus viewpoint, a great free view.
Uphill. From L3 Vallcarca there are outdoor escalators on Baixada de la Glòria.

dontMiss: Coffee on a terrace facing the church of Sant Joan.
Independent shops, vintage and cafés. Cines Verdi shows films in original version.

goodToKnow: Lively on a Saturday night; lots of small bars around the square.

dontMiss: Gaudí's first house: tiled façade with marigolds, very different from his later work.
A 360° view of the whole city as the lights come on.
The Sagrada Família and the sea lined up in one view.
goodToKnow: Civil War anti-aircraft battery; now a free hilltop.
Get there 30–45 min before sunset for a good spot.
It's windy, so bring your jacket. There are no shops at the top, so buy drinks on the way.
Bus V17 or a taxi up. Keep the noise down on the way out; people live here.

dontMiss: The Nativity façade (Carrer de la Marina side), Gaudí's own work, where you queue.
The Passion façade (Subirachs): look for the magic square where every row adds up to 33.
Inside: the tree-like columns branching into a forest canopy.
Stained glass: blue/green on the east side in the morning, orange/red on the west in the afternoon.
Plaça de Gaudí's pond for the classic reflection photo of the Nativity façade.
goodToKnow: Mass: doors 8:30, mass 9:00, ~1 h. No photos during mass.
Covered shoulders. Tickets are name-checked against ID.

dontMiss: The 'house of bones' façade: mask-like balconies and bone-shaped pillars.
The roof, shaped like a dragon's back, with Saint George's cross-shaped tower.
Inside: the mushroom-shaped fireplace and the noble floor's wavy windows.
The light well, where the tiles go from deep to pale blue so the light spreads evenly.
The rooftop chimneys (Silver ticket and up).
goodToKnow: Next door: Casa Amatller and Casa Lleó Morera, the 'Block of Discord' with three modernista architects in one block.

dontMiss: The rippling stone façade and wrought-iron balconies from the opposite pavement.
The 'warrior' chimneys on the roof, if you go in.
The Sunday morning book & collectibles market around the building (Dominical).
Vermut in a traditional bodega on the surrounding streets.
goodToKnow: Vermut hour is late morning / pre-lunch, with olives and chips.

dontMiss: The Cascada fountain.
Rowing boats on the lake.
Arc de Triomf at the top of Passeig de Lluís Companys.
Sunset from the terrace in front of the MNAC, looking down Avinguda Maria Cristina.
The Magic Fountain below. The schedule varies, so check before you go.
goodToKnow: Montjuïc gets cool after sunset, so bring your light layer.

dontMiss: A pintxos crawl, bar to bar.
goodToKnow: Pintxos cost ~€1–2.50 each. Keep your toothpicks, because that's how they count the bill.
Pickpocket hotspot: front pocket or zipped bag.
Most shops shut on Monday 12 Oct (public holiday).
The Boqueria market is usually closed on Sundays and holidays.

dontMiss: The cloister with its 13 white geese.
The lampposts, early Gaudí designs.
The wavy, multicoloured mosaic roof.

goodToKnow: A 15-min walk up Avinguda de Gaudí from the Sagrada Família.
Vueling VY8101 leaves at 11:20 Athens time. Aim to be there by ~09:20.
Online check-in and boarding pass in the Vueling app.
~7 min walk from the hotel, entrance on Via Augusta.
To the centre: any train towards Plaça Catalunya, 4 stops (~8 min).
From the centre: L6, S1 or S2 stop here. L7 does not.
T-casual valid (zone 1).

events.label: 11:20 ATH
events.title: Flight VY8101 Athens → Barcelona
events.description: Vueling VY8101. Athens 11:20 → Barcelona Terminal 1 at 13:45 (local times). Be at Athens airport by ~09:20 and keep your boarding pass offline.

events.title: Land at T1 → hotel
events.description: 1) Outside T1 arrivals take Aerobús A1 to Plaça Catalunya (last stop, ~35 min, €12.85 return; buy the return, you'll use it Monday). 2) At Plaça Catalunya take FGC L6, S1 or S2 to Muntaner (4 stops, ~8 min, T-casual valid; not L7). 3) Walk ~7 min to Carrer de Santaló 8. Door to door ~1 h 15 min. Taxi instead: ~30 min, roughly €35–45.

events.title: Check in at Zenit Barcelona
events.description: Check-in is from 14:00. Tourist tax is paid here.

events.title: Late lunch near the hotel
events.description: Menú del día is usually served until ~16:00 on weekdays. Otherwise grab tapas and keep it light before the museum.

events.title: Picasso Museum
events.description: Carrer de Montcada, El Born. ~1.5 h. Don't miss the Las Meninas series. From the hotel: FGC to Catalunya, then ~15 min walk (~35 min total), or a ~15 min taxi.

events.title: Free roam: El Born → the sea
events.description: Santa Maria del Mar and Passeig del Born are 2–4 min from the museum. Drift down to Barceloneta for the sunset colours (~19:15, ~20 min walk). Catch the Palau de la Música façade another time if you run late.

events.title: Dinner in El Born
events.description: El Born is full of small tapas and wine bars. Dinner from 21:00, like the locals. Back to the hotel by FGC (runs until ~midnight on weekdays, later on Fri/Sat) or taxi (~15 min).

days.name: Saturday
days.theme: Park Güell · a day in Gràcia · Bunkers sunset

events.title: Park Güell
events.description: First slot, before the crowds. Dragon stairway, the wavy bench, the view. ~1.5 h.

events.title: Free roam: Gràcia
events.description: Walk downhill into Barcelona's village-like neighbourhood. Coffee in Plaça de la Virreina, browse Carrer de Verdi, long lunch outside in a square. No agenda.

events.title: Hotel, change
events.description: Recharge before the evening.

events.title: Bunkers del Carmel at sunset
events.description: Free hilltop, 360° view of the city. Locals bring a beer and watch the lights come on. Take a jacket. Bus V17 or taxi up.

events.title: Dinner in Gràcia
events.description: Short ride down. Plaça del Sol is lively on a Saturday night.

days.name: Sunday
days.theme: Sagrada Família · Passeig de Gràcia · lazy Sunday

events.title: Sagrada Família — mass
events.description: Queue at the Carrer de la Marina door. Doors 8:30, mass 9:00, ~1 h. Free. No photos during mass. Walk round the façades afterwards.

events.title: Casa Batlló (optional inside)
events.description: ~20 min walk down to Passeig de Gràcia. Inside ~1 h if booked; otherwise enjoy the façade and La Pedrera next door.

events.title: Free roam: vermut & the Sunday feeling
events.description: Vermouth, olives and chips before lunch (Sant Antoni or Poble Sec). Then Ciutadella Park or the sand — do nothing like everyone else.

events.title: Montjuïc & Poble Sec
events.description: Sunset from the MNAC steps, then walk down to Carrer de Blai for a cheap pintxos crawl.

events.title: Pack, check out, leave bags
events.description: Check-out is by 12:00. Do it now and ask reception to keep your bags until ~14:30, so you're free for the morning.

events.title: Free roam: slow goodbye
events.description: Public holiday: shops shut, city relaxed. Breakfast somewhere nice, then La Rambla for the last day of the Festes del Roser. If a Sagrada ticket turned up, this is its slot.

events.title: Final lunch near the hotel
events.description: Eat in Sant Gervasi so collecting your bags is a short walk.

events.title: To the airport: FGC + Aerobús A1
events.description: 1) Walk ~7 min to FGC Muntaner (Via Augusta). 2) Any train to Plaça Catalunya (4 stops, ~8 min). 3) Aerobús A1 (Terminal 1) from Plaça Catalunya, ~35 min, using your return ticket. You'll reach T1 ~15:50, 2 h 20 min before the flight. Taxi instead: leave the hotel by ~15:15, ~30 min, roughly €35–45.

events.title: Flight A3743 Barcelona → Athens
events.description: Aegean A3743 from Terminal 1, 18:10 → Athens 21:55 (local time). Light fare: no checked bag, so check the cabin-bag size before you pack. Check in online in the Aegean app.

items.title: Park Güell
items.note: Timed slot, Saturday 9:30. Long weekend, so slots go fast. You get 30 min grace after your slot time.

items.title: Picasso Museum
items.note: €14 online (€15 at the door). Book the 17:00 slot on Friday: you land at 13:45. Daily visitor cap, so book a timed slot.

items.title: Casa Batlló
items.note: From €29 (Blue); the rooftop needs Silver, from €34. Prices rise closer to the date.

items.title: Sagrada Família ticket
items.note: Sold out for now. Check sagradafamilia.org daily for cancellations. Plan B: guided tour via GetYourGuide (~€89). Plan C: the free Sunday 9:00 mass (already in the plan). A ticket would go in the Monday morning slot.

items.title: Vueling online check-in · VY8101
items.note: Fri 9 Oct: Athens 11:20 → Barcelona T1 13:45. Save the boarding pass offline.

items.title: Aegean online check-in · A3743
items.note: Mon 12 Oct: Barcelona T1 18:10 → Athens 21:55. Light fare, so no checked bag: check the cabin-bag allowance.

items.title: Aerobús return
items.note: €12.85 return (€7.45 single). Take A1 both ways: both your flights use Terminal 1.

items.title: T-casual card
items.note: 10 metro/bus/FGC rides for €11.35. Covers the FGC train between the hotel (Muntaner) and Plaça Catalunya. Not valid on the Aerobús. Buy at any metro or FGC machine.

items.title: Zenit Barcelona: tourist tax & bag storage
items.note: Tourist tax is paid at the hotel (~€20–25 per person for 3 nights). Ask to store bags on Monday after checkout.

items.title: Photo ID / passport
items.note: Sagrada tickets are name-checked against ID.

items.title: Comfortable shoes
items.note: You'll walk a lot. Park Güell and the Bunkers are uphill.

items.title: Light layer
items.note: October evenings get cool, especially at the Bunkers and Montjuïc.

items.title: Power bank + cable
items.note: Live GPS tracking drains the battery.

items.title: Small zipped bag / front-pocket wallet
items.note: Pickpockets on the metro, La Rambla and the beach.

items.title: Plug adapter (Type C/F)
items.note: Only if you're coming from outside the EU.

nudges.title: Grab a jacket
nudges.text: The Bunkers get windy after sunset.

nudges.title: Tomorrow: Sagrada mass
nudges.text: Queue at 8:15 at the Carrer de la Marina door. Covered shoulders, bring ID.

nudges.title: Got a Sagrada ticket?
nudges.text: If one turned up, this morning is its slot.

nudges.title: Flying tomorrow
nudges.text: VY8101 leaves Athens at 11:20. Check in online and save the boarding pass offline.

nudges.title: Aegean check-in
nudges.text: Check in online for A3743 (18:10, T1) and save the boarding pass.

rows.note: Free from outside · €29 Blue · €34+ with rooftop

total.note: Aerobús + T-casual + Park Güell + Picasso + tax

guide.title: Eat late
guide.text: Lunch 14:00–16:00, dinner from 21:00. A restaurant that's full at 19:30 is full of tourists.

guide.title: Menú del día
guide.text: Weekday set lunch — the best-value meal in town. Not usually offered at weekends.

guide.title: Vermut
guide.text: Late-morning / pre-lunch vermouth on weekends, with olives and chips. Very Barcelona.

guide.title: Sundays & holidays
guide.text: Most shops shut Sunday and Monday 12 Oct; bars and restaurants stay open.

guide.title: Museums & Mondays
guide.text: Most museums close on Mondays — that's why Picasso is on Friday.

guide.title: Pickpockets
guide.text: Front pocket or zipped bag on the metro, La Rambla and at the beach. Never leave your phone on the table.

guide.title: Getting lost
guide.text: Best way to see the city: pick a neighbourhood, put the phone away, stop wherever looks good. Gràcia, El Born and Sant Antoni reward this most.

guide.title: Catalan basics
guide.text: Bon dia (good morning) · Gràcies (thanks) · Si us plau (please) · Adéu (bye).

hotel.name: Zenit Barcelona
hotel.address: Carrer de Santaló 8, Sant Gervasi, 08021 Barcelona

goodToKnow: Check-in from 14:00 (Fri). Check-out by 12:00 (Mon).
Nearest train: FGC Muntaner on Via Augusta, ~7 min walk. Trains from there go straight to Plaça Catalunya (~8 min).
The tourist tax is paid here (~€20–25 per person for 3 nights).
Ask to store your bags on Monday after you check out.
